purpose: Turn the proposed matter-fed, matter-screened gravitational-load idea into eleven dimensionally closed executable branches, preserve orthodox conflicts as separately graded counterexamples, and freeze a target-blind Cosmicflows-4 by SDSS-DR7-void test before observational responses are opened.

origin.interpretation_rule: Explore empirical predictions before grading consistency with established physics; neither an orthodox conflict nor a synthetic success is a data rejection or discovery.
origin.path_measure: dell=-u_a dx^a>0 for the future-directed baryonic matter congruence u^a with u_a u^a=-1; dt_b=dell/c. A null affine parameter is never used as distance or photon proper time.

parameters.synthetic_unit_statement: Numerical fixtures use c=dx=1 and dimensionless numerical densities while retaining the physical dimensions declared above.

limits: v_los=0 gives pure FLRW
a_o=a_e gives the special-relativistic radial Doppler control
equivalences: mandatory nuisance/control, not a new load law

branches.field_law: Q is an externally specified scalar load in the synthetic fixture
branches.photon_law: d ln(nu)/dt_b=-eta Q; Delta ln(nu)=-(eta/c) integral Q dell
limits: eta=0 gives no additional redshift
Q=0 gives no additional redshift
equivalences: constant Q is exactly degenerate with an exponential distance-redshift law on one distance range

branches.field_law: Q is externally specified and must satisfy 1+beta Q>0
branches.photon_law: c_eff=c/(1+beta Q); Delta ln(nu)=-(eta/c) integral [Q+beta Q^2] dell
limits: beta=0 reduces exactly to VQ01 on the same Q
eta=0 leaves arrival delay but removes redshift
equivalences: its first-order beta=0 spectrum is VQ01; the Q^2 morphology term is the discriminator

limits: Gamma_b=0 removes density screening
uniform J_g and rho_b produce constant Q
equivalences: the local steady D_g=0 limit of VQ05

branches.field_law: J_g(x)=A_feed integral K_L(|x-x'|) rho_b(x') d^3x'; K_L=exp(-r/L_g)/(4 pi L_g^2 r); Q=J_g/(Gamma_0+Gamma_b rho_b)
limits: homogeneous density gives J_g=A_feed rho_b for a normalized infinite-domain kernel
L_g controls smoothing rather than a new photon coupling
equivalences: reduces to VQ03 when its computed J_g is supplied to the local equilibrium law

limits: D_g=0 at steady state reduces pointwise to VQ03
uniform steady sources have Q=J_g/(Gamma_0+Gamma_b rho_b)
equivalences: not distinct from VQ03 in the frozen uniform steady fixture; transient and spatial smoothing fixtures separate them

branches.field_law: Q(x)=A_load integral rho_b(x') K_L(r) exp[-sigma_g Sigma_b(x',x)] d^3x'
limits: sigma_g=0 gives unattenuated Yukawa load
A_load=0 gives Q=0
equivalences: not equivalent to VQ04 because attenuation depends on intervening baryonic column

limits: n=0 gives Q=1 and a pure exponential Hubble mimic
rho_star>0 prevents a void divergence
equivalences: constant line-of-sight mean Q is observationally degenerate with rescaling H_g

branches.field_law: each path cell is void if rho_b/rho_bar<0.65 and matter-rich otherwise
limits: H_v=H_m gives a path-independent exponential Hubble mimic
L_v=0 or L_m=0 gives the corresponding single phase
equivalences: a binary coarse graining of VQ07, not a microscopic explanation

limits: a=0 and q_gamma(emit)=0 gives no load
b_0+b_b rho_b>0 gives finite memory
eta_gamma=0 decouples frequency from memory
equivalences: fast relaxation approximates a local Q-weighted optical law; finite relaxation is order-sensitive

branches.field_law: Q solves VQ05 and must satisfy 1+beta Q>0
branches.photon_law: c_eff=c/(1+beta Q); Delta ln(nu)=-(eta/c) integral [Q+beta Q^2] dell
branches.dimension_check: VQ05 dimensions plus the dimensionless VQ02 exposure
limits: beta=0 gives VQ01 evaluated on the reservoir Q
D_g=0 at steady state gives VQ02 evaluated on VQ03
eta=0 preserves only the travel-time prediction
equivalences: its steady local beta=0 boundary is not a new branch; joint transient, Q^2, and delay signatures are

empirical_preflight.primary_question: At independently measured distance and after a frozen peculiar-flow model, does signed redshift residual increase with foreground void path length or continuous low-density exposure?

sources.expected_payload: exact machine-readable CF4 group/galaxy distance table to be selected by an independent source receipt
required_fields: heliocentric and CMB-frame redshift or velocity

sources.expected_payload: VAST VIDE zone/member geometry plus survey mask and sample-cosmology metadata; also freeze VoidFinder and REVOLVER tables as algorithmic controls
required_fields: member/zone geometry sufficient for line intersection

sources.expected_payload: Pantheon+ Hubble-diagram table and total covariance from one immutable repository revision

empirical_preflight.object_join: Resolve CF4 group coordinates and identifiers without redshift-nearest matching. Deduplicate at group level before splitting. Pantheon+ is an independent cross-check and is never used to tune CF4 coefficients.
intersection_algorithm: Convert observer, target, and void geometry to the catalog's explicitly frozen comoving Cartesian convention using only the catalog cosmology.
Represent each sightline by x(s)=s*n_hat for 0<s<D_independent; D_independent comes from CF4, never cz/H0.

Calibrate the mapping from released redshift-space void geometry to true-space chord exposure on frozen survey mocks spanning the Chuang et al. void-beta/RSD uncertainty; carry the resulting exposure error and selection covariance into the likelihood.

Primary geometry uses the released VIDE member/zone boundary if sufficient. Compute ordered ray/zone boundary intersections and sum only intervals whose midpoint is inside the released void zone and survey mask.

If released zone topology is insufficient, do not silently use spheres: source-block the primary test. A predeclared robustness approximation may intersect ellipsoids fitted only from released member geometry; the spherical R_eff chord is a labeled tertiary sensitivity test.
For the spherical sensitivity only, solve |s*n_hat-x_v|^2=R_eff^2, clip roots to [0,D], union overlapping intervals, and never double count nested or overlapping voids.
Return L_void, f_void=L_void/D, number of crossings, maximum chord, ordered chord vector, edge-clipped fraction, and continuous density exposure if the released geometry supports it.
Reject targets outside the frozen DR7 angular/radial mask; do not impute zero void exposure beyond catalog coverage.

splits.unit: CF4 group, with all member galaxies kept in the same fold
splits.rule: SHA256(canonical CF4 group identifier) first 8 bytes mod 10
splits.stratification: report but do not alter folds by distance method, distance quintile, sky sector, group richness, and VAST algorithm

comparators: FLRW cosmographic distance-redshift relation with frozen H0,q0 or a declared low-z series
published CF4 peculiar-flow correction and a no-flow CMB-frame sensitivity
Hoffman et al. bias Gaussianization and a forward lognormal distance-modulus likelihood
bulk flow plus shear fit on development folds only
local density at target and observer separated from foreground path exposure
VAST VoidFinder and REVOLVER geometry as algorithmic controls
random sky rotations preserving distance and mask
redshift-scrambled void catalogs within survey strata
mock-calibrated true-space exposure with void-beta/RSD uncertainty and redshift-space-only sensitivity
Local Void dynamical outflow and reconstructed peculiar velocity following the Cosmicflows Local Void analysis
empirical_preflight.likelihood: Hierarchical Student-t likelihood for y_i=ln(1+z_CMB)-ln(1+z_FLRW(D_i))-registered peculiar-flow term, with published distance uncertainty propagated in latent D_i, distance-method intercepts, group random effects, sky-sector covariance, and one predeclared exposure coefficient per branch. Pantheon+ uses its full released covariance and a separately frozen intercept; no covariance diagonalization shortcut.
empirical_preflight.primary_statistic: validation and sealed-confirmation log predictive density difference versus the best registered FLRW+flow comparator, together with the sign-consistent standardized coefficient for L_void/D at fixed D

thresholds.advance_interesting_observation: same predeclared sign in development, validation and sealed confirmation; |z_coefficient|>=3 in sealed confirmation; Delta elpd>=10 versus FLRW+flow; and no random-rotation or redshift-scramble control reaches the observed statistic in more than 1 percent of 1000 frozen permutations
thresholds.advance_mechanism_candidate: interesting-observation gate plus transfer across at least two independent distance-method strata and both VIDE and one other VAST algorithm, while local-density-only, sky-sector, distance-method and flow comparators do not absorb the signal
thresholds.falsify_frozen_branch_on_this_test: sealed coefficient has the opposite sign with |z|>=3 or its 95 percent interval excludes the branch's frozen minimum effect after calibration on development only
thresholds.inconclusive: otherwise; source absence is SOURCE_BLOCKED, never a model failure

empirical_preflight.no_retuning: Choose nuisance priors, exposure normalization, branch parameter grid and effect threshold from development only; lock a content hash before validation; never alter after any validation or confirmation residual is opened.
empirical_preflight.parameter_grid_rule: The first empirical executor must freeze a finite dimensionful grid from external constraints or development only. This theory packet intentionally supplies no fitted cosmic eta, beta, Gamma, D_g, L_g or H_g values.
empirical_preflight.minimum_effect_rule: A branch cannot be falsified for small amplitude until its nonzero amplitude is fixed independently; zero is retained as a nested null wherever mathematically permitted. Shape/sign tests may still reject a frozen nonzero realization.
empirical_preflight.circularity_warning: The void catalogs are inferred from redshift-space galaxy positions. Independent CF4 distances, mock-calibrated real-space reconstruction with void-beta/RSD uncertainty, random rotations and alternate void finders are mandatory; a correlation with the same redshifts used to build geometry is not independent evidence.

decision_policy.orthodoxy_rule: Do not discard a branch merely because it conflicts with a standard model. Compute its signature first, then record empirical fit, internal mathematical closure, established-physics consistency, and novelty as separate axes.
decision_policy.lead_discriminator: At matched independent distance and endpoints, VQ09 predicts different redshift for the same total void and matter columns when their order is reversed; VQ10 instead predicts a fixed same-field pairing of nonlinear Q^2 redshift exposure and positive arrival-time delay. FLRW plus a static endpoint peculiar velocity predicts neither ordering memory nor that paired propagation-delay relation.
decision_policy.publication_gate: A theory/methods note may report the taxonomy, exact equivalences, executable fixtures and frozen discriminator. An observational claim requires receipted payloads, sealed confirmation, independent audit and all registered controls. A gravity discovery additionally requires a receiver/action or common metric/matter/light completion and cross-probe survival.
